<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F9FAFA"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <text x="22" y="22" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#121212">9:41</text>
  <rect x="320" y="14" width="3" height="7" rx="1" fill="#121212"/>
  <rect x="326" y="11" width="3" height="10" rx="1" fill="#121212"/>
  <rect x="332" y="8" width="3" height="13" rx="1" fill="#121212"/>
  <circle cx="347" cy="15" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="347" y1="15" x2="353" y2="9" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <rect x="361" y="9" width="21" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="363.5" y="11.5" width="15" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#5DB329"/>
  <rect x="383" y="13" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#121212"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <polyline points="29,57 21,65 29,73" fill="none" stroke="#0A2533" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <line x1="22" y1="65" x2="39" y2="65" stroke="#0A2533" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <text x="195" y="71" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="500" fill="#0A2533">Bank Details</text>
  <line x1="22" y1="91" x2="368" y2="91" stroke="#E6EBF2" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Instruction -->
  <g>
    <rect x="22" y="111" width="346" height="66" rx="10" fill="#EAF7E3"/>
    <circle cx="47" cy="140" r="14" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <line x1="47" y1="133" x2="47" y2="143" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="47" cy="148" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="72" y="134" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">
      <tspan x="72" dy="0">Enter the account details linked to your</tspan>
      <tspan x="72" dy="19">payment account. Your information is secure.</tspan>
    </text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bank selector -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="201" width="342" height="61" rx="10" fill="#063336" opacity="0.08"/>
    <rect x="22" y="199" width="342" height="61" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="38" y="218" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">
      <tspan x="38" dy="0">Bank</tspan>
      <tspan x="38" dy="23" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#121212">Select your bank</tspan>
    </text>
    <polyline points="338,223 344,229 350,223" fill="none" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Account number -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="283" width="342" height="61" rx="10" fill="#063336" opacity="0.08"/>
    <rect x="22" y="281" width="342" height="61" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="38" y="300" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">
      <tspan x="38" dy="0">Account number</tspan>
      <tspan x="38" dy="23" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#999999">Enter account number</tspan>
    </text>
    <circle cx="340" cy="311" r="10" fill="#F3FAF6" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1"/>
    <polyline points="335,311 339,315 346,307" fill="none" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- CNIC -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="365" width="342" height="61" rx="10" fill="#063336" opacity="0.08"/>
    <rect x="22" y="363" width="342" height="61" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="38" y="382" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">
      <tspan x="38" dy="0">CNIC number</tspan>
      <tspan x="38" dy="23" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#999999">Enter 13-digit CNIC number</tspan>
    </text>
    <circle cx="340" cy="393" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C7C7C7" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="340" y1="388" x2="340" y2="395" stroke="#666666" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="340" cy="399" r="1" fill="#666666"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Confirmation details -->
  <g>
    <rect x="22" y="450" width="346" height="108" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E6EBF2" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="478" r="14" fill="#D4FCBC"/>
    <polyline points="42,478 47,483 55,473" fill="none" stroke="#267347" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="75" y="479" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#0A2533">Payment protection</text>
    <text x="38" y="510" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">
      <tspan x="38" dy="0">We will only use these details to process</tspan>
      <tspan x="38" dy="19">your payment. Double-check before confirming.</tspan>
    </text>
    <line x1="38" y1="537" x2="352" y2="537" stroke="#EEEEEE" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Confirm button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="22" y="604" width="346" height="60" rx="10" fill="#063336" opacity="0.12"/>
    <rect x="22" y="601" width="346" height="60" rx="10" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <text x="195" y="638" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Confirm payment</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Secure caption -->
  <circle cx="142" cy="687" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <polyline points="140,687 142,689 146,684" fill="none" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="153" y="691" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Secure and encrypted transaction</text>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="755" width="390" height="89" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="755" x2="390" y2="755" stroke="#E6EBF2" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Home -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,780 49,772 59,780" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <rect x="42" y="779" width="14" height="12" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="49" y="812" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#97A2B0">Home</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Orders -->
  <g>
    <rect x="126" y="773" width="18" height="18" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="130" y1="779" x2="140" y2="779" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="130" y1="784" x2="140" y2="784" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="135" y="812" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#97A2B0">Orders</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Wallet active -->
  <g>
    <rect x="210" y="775" width="22" height="16" rx="3" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <line x1="210" y1="779" x2="232" y2="779" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="226" cy="784" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="221" y="812" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#5DB329">Wallet</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Profile -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="317" cy="778" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <ellipse cx="317" cy="789" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="317" y="812" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#97A2B0">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
